results.sql:
SELECT e.composition_formula, e.prototype_label
FROM oqmd_entries e
WHERE e.prototype_label IN ('L1₂', 'L12')
ORDER BY e.composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT oqmd_entries.composition_formula
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios
  ON oqmd_entries.entry_key = oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.symbol = 'Ni'
ORDER BY oqmd_entries.composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  composition_formula AS formula,
  lattice_param_a AS lattice_a
FROM oqmd_entries
WHERE lattice_param_a < 4
ORDER BY lattice_param_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  oqmd_entries.composition_formula AS formula,
  oqmd_formation_energies.gap_ev AS band_gap_value
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_formation_energies.gap_ev IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY oqmd_formation_energies.gap_ev DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS on_hull_compound_count
FROM oqmd_formation_energies
WHERE on_hull = TRUE
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  e.composition_formula AS formula,
  fe.delta_e AS formation_energy_per_atom,
  fe.hull_distance AS energy_above_hull,
  fe.on_hull AS is_stable
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE fe.delta_e < -0.5
ORDER BY fe.hull_distance ASC, fe.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT symbol AS element, COUNT(DISTINCT entry_key) AS entry_count
FROM oqmd_element_ratios
GROUP BY symbol
ORDER BY entry_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
  oqmd_entries.composition_formula,
  oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e,
  oqmd_formation_energies.hull_distance,
  oqmd_formation_energies.on_hull
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios
  ON oqmd_entries.entry_key = oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.symbol = 'Al'
  AND oqmd_formation_energies.on_hull = TRUE
ORDER BY oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  oqmd_entries.crystal_system,
  AVG(oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e) AS avg_eform
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_entries.entry_key = oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key
GROUP BY oqmd_entries.crystal_system
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS metastable_compounds_below_0_05_ev_atom_count
FROM oqmd_formation_energies
WHERE hull_distance < 0.05
  AND on_hull = false
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT oqmd_entries.composition_formula
FROM oqmd_entries
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM oqmd_element_ratios
    WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
      AND oqmd_element_ratios.symbol = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM oqmd_element_ratios
    WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
      AND oqmd_element_ratios.symbol = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY oqmd_entries.composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    oqmd_entries.composition_formula AS formula,
    oqmd_element_ratios.symbol AS element,
    oqmd_element_ratios.wyckoff_site AS site_label,
    oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e AS formation_energy_per_atom
FROM oqmd_element_ratios
JOIN oqmd_entries
    ON oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
    ON oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.symbol = 'Co'
  AND oqmd_element_ratios.wyckoff_site = 'A-site'
ORDER BY oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  oqmd_entries.composition_formula AS formula,
  oqmd_formation_energies.gap_ev AS band_gap_value
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_entries.entry_key = oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_entries.spacegroup_number = 221
  AND oqmd_formation_energies.gap_ev > 0
ORDER BY oqmd_formation_energies.gap_ev DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  symbol,
  polymorph_count,
  gs_spacegroup
FROM oqmd_reference_states
ORDER BY polymorph_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    er.symbol AS element,
    AVG(fe.hull_distance) AS avg_hull_distance
FROM oqmd_element_ratios er
JOIN oqmd_entries e
    ON er.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe
    ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE er.atomic_ratio = 0.75
GROUP BY er.symbol
ORDER BY AVG(fe.hull_distance) ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  oqmd_entries.composition_formula,
  oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e,
  SUM(oqmd_element_ratios.atomic_ratio * oqmd_reference_states.energy_pa) AS reference_energy_pa,
  oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e - SUM(oqmd_element_ratios.atomic_ratio * oqmd_reference_states.energy_pa) AS formation_enthalpy_pa
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios
  ON oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_elements
  ON oqmd_elements.symbol = oqmd_element_ratios.symbol
JOIN oqmd_reference_states
  ON oqmd_reference_states.symbol = oqmd_elements.symbol
WHERE oqmd_entries.composition_formula = 'Co3Ti'
GROUP BY
  oqmd_entries.entry_key,
  oqmd_entries.composition_formula,
  oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e
ORDER BY formation_enthalpy_pa ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT e.composition_formula,
       e.prototype_label,
       f.delta_e
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies f ON f.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE f.on_hull = true
  AND e.prototype_label IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
  AND f.delta_e < -0.3
ORDER BY f.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT oer.symbol AS a_site,
       AVG(ofe.delta_e) AS avg_formation_enthalpy,
       COUNT(DISTINCT oe.entry_key) AS count
FROM oqmd_entries oe
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies ofe ON ofe.entry_key = oe.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios oer ON oer.entry_key = oe.entry_key
WHERE (oe.prototype_label = 'L12' OR oe.prototype_label = 'L1₂')
  AND ofe.on_hull = TRUE
  AND oer.wyckoff_site = 'A-site'
GROUP BY oer.symbol
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy ASC
LIMIT 10000;
